cases: A dog is running through the grass.
A puppy runs across a green field.
The spacecraft entered orbit around Mars.
input_policy: Pinned tokenizer, no truncation, right padding to 32, zero segment IDs, positions 0 through 31, 0/1 padding mask with at least one valid token
local_numerical_bound: 2e-5 * (1 + abs(independent reference using actual GPU predecessors)); transport checks remain exact
complete_policy_reference_bound: 2e-4 * (1 + abs(independent half-transport FP64 graph reference)) on final normalized embedding
repeat_requirement: Three different text inputs in one prepared native process, followed by a repeat of the first; no host model activation reconstruction
framework_control: Original graph FP64 result versus independent eager Transformers BertModel in FP64
scope: No GPU result exists when this contract is written; failures remain failures and bounds must not be widened retrospectively
